command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Continue'
Write-Output '--- WSL-LIST ---'
$tmp=[System.IO.Path]::GetTempFileName()
$p=Start-Process -FilePath 'wsl.exe' -ArgumentList @('--list','--verbose') -NoNewWindow -Wait -PassThru -RedirectStandardOutput "$tmp.o" -RedirectStandardError "$tmp.e"
Write-Output "EXIT=$($p.ExitCode)"
(Get-Content "$tmp.o" -Encoding Unicode -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) -join "`n"
(Get-Content "$tmp.e" -Encoding Unicode -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) -join "`n"
Write-Output '--- WSL-VERSION ---'
$p=Start-Process -FilePath 'wsl.exe' -ArgumentList @('--version') -NoNewWindow -Wait -PassThru -RedirectStandardOutput "$tmp.o2" -RedirectStandardError "$tmp.e2"
Write-Output "EXIT=$($p.ExitCode)"
(Get-Content "$tmp.o2" -Encoding Unicode -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) -join "`n"
Write-Output '--- DOCKER-DESKTOP-DISTRO-DXG ---'
$p=Start-Process -FilePath 'wsl.exe' -ArgumentList @('-d','docker-desktop','sh','-c','ls -l /dev/dxg; ls /usr/lib/wsl/lib | head; ls /usr/lib/wsl/drivers 2>&1 | head -3') -NoNewWindow -Wait -PassThru -RedirectStandardOutput "$tmp.o3" -RedirectStandardError "$tmp.e3"
Write-Output "EXIT=$($p.ExitCode)"
(Get-Content "$tmp.o3" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) -join "`n"
(Get-Content "$tmp.e3" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) -join "`n"
Write-Output '--- DOCKER-DESKTOP-NVIDIA-SMI ---'
$p=Start-Process -FilePath 'wsl.exe' -ArgumentList @('-d','docker-desktop','sh','-c','/usr/lib/wsl/lib/nvidia-smi -L 2>&1 || echo NO_WSL_NVIDIA_SMI') -NoNewWindow -Wait -PassThru -RedirectStandardOutput "$tmp.o4" -RedirectStandardError "$tmp.e4"
Write-Output "EXIT=$($p.ExitCode)"
(Get-Content "$tmp.o4" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) -join "`n"
(Get-Content "$tmp.e4" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) -join "`n"
Remove-Item "$tmp*" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Write-Output '--- RC ---'
